working_geometry_plain: The working L7 geometry is a finite nested Hopf shell/projection layer carried by PEPS3D spinor anchors. The scout earns finite shell indices, finite phase-grid Hopf spinors, shell projection classes pi_shell(v,k,phi,chi)=(v,k), fiber/base loop connection readouts, and a base-loop shell/order witness. The order witness is the Hopf connection residual, not a downstream flux or Axis0 object. This is still a local finite layer lego, not stacked manifold closure, flux, Axis0, physics, or final manifold evidence.
